title: Bread for the Festival
story: On festival morning, the square smelled of fresh bread. Luca helped his aunt at a table. They sold round loaves and a sweet rice dish from her region. A tourist asked about the red spice, and Luca said it was mild. His aunt wrapped a roll for a child with no money. When the music started, a few loaves were left. Luca saved one for dinner.
